[Alpha-Pharma Healthcare](https://www.alpha-pharma.com/) manufactures a wide range of pharmaceutical products, focusing heavily on hormone replacement therapies, men's health, oncology, and general therapeutics. Because multiple distinct companies share the name Alpha Pharma or Alpha Pharmaceuticals globally (including major lines in India and regional distributors), product lines vary by the specific corporate entity. [](https://alphapharma.com.sa/products/)

- **Hormone Replacement & Tropic Hormones:** Treatments targeting hormonal imbalances and deficiencies.

- **Men's Health:** Specialized prescription medications, including products like _Altamofen_ and _Tamsulin_.

- **Oncology:**

Specialized cancer care medications such as _Letromina_.

- **SERMs (Selective Estrogen Receptor Modulators):** Compounds used in targeted hormone modulation.

- **Thyroid Care & Weight Loss:** Metabolic and endocrine management treatments.

- **General Health & Common Diseases:** Standard lines of tablets, capsules, and suspensions for everyday clinical care. [](https://www.indiamart.com/alpha-pharma-healthcare/aboutus.html)
